0.0: Good work, Kaiser. Our next target is the castle itself. It has been too long since I set foot in there...
0.1: Anyway, to secure the central region, we must reinforce our position. We are closer than ever to our foes.
0.2: The Specters have been thrown off-guard at the moment, but they could rally and attack at any time. We need to reinforce before they get their wits about them. Check in with Captain #b#p3001001##k and #b#p3001007##k, and get their reports.

yes.0: Come report back to me after you have talked with #b#p3001001# and #p3001007##k.

no.0: I suppose you do need some time to rest.

1.0: You're back. What did they have to report?\r\n#L0##bWell, it's not much you haven't already heard...#l\n#k
1.1: Yes, we are all in agreement. We must fortify this position before proceeding further. I knew that, but thanks for running about and confirming, Kaiser.

yes.0: I'll work on our next plan, but there's something I need help with in the meantime. Let me know when you're ready.

quest.0: You surely could not have completed your task that quickly. Get the reports from #b#p3001001# and #p3001007##k.
